verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents personal access tokens for the REST API and Git over HTTPS that carry only the permissions you grant and always expire, so permission scoping and expiry are covered. Nothing shows these tokens can be limited to specific repositories; the 'Only select repositories' option applies to MCP connections, not tokens, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented per-repository scoping of tokens, detail on the permission granularity and expiry settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
